strategies.name: premarket_level_breakout_or_retest_continuation_5m_2m

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: mark the highest high of that price action and the lowest low of that price action
entry_sequence.action: Mark the pre-market high and low from 3:00 a.m. EST until the 9:30 a.m. open on the 5-minute chart.
entry_sequence.rationale: These levels define the breakout/retest/sweep area.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we want to see the break and we actually want to see the close above or below the level
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a lower-timeframe candle to close above or below the pre-market level for the breakout trigger.
entry_sequence.rationale: A close beyond the level confirms the break.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: looking for an increase in the volume to confirm that the breakout is actually valid
entry_sequence.action: Require elevated volume to confirm the breakout is valid.
entry_sequence.rationale: Volume confirms participation behind the move.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: look for price to pull back down into this previous high over here, make it support to go long
entry_sequence.action: Or wait for a retest of the broken level and take the trade when it holds as support or resistance.
entry_sequence.rationale: Retest confirmation can provide a safer entry after the break.

stop.transcript_quote: The stop is always going to go on the opposite side of the entry candle.
stop.rationale: "The stop is always going to go on the opposite side of the entry candle."

strategies.stop_management: Move the stop-loss up to at least break even, ideally in profits, and let it run.

targets.transcript_quote: bare minimum of 1x of my original risk
targets.rationale: "I'm typically looking for bare minimum of 1x of my original risk."

targets.transcript_quote: ideally what I'm looking for is a 1.5x to a 2x my original risk
targets.rationale: "ideally what I'm looking for is a 1.5x to a 2x my original risk."

confluences.name: 3am_start
confluences.description: Use the pre-market window starting at 3:00 a.m. Eastern time.

confluences.transcript_quote: all the way up into New York market open, which is going to be 9:30 a.m. EST
confluences.name: ny_open_window
confluences.description: Trade the levels from 3:00 a.m. Eastern time into the New York open at 9:30 a.m. EST.

confluences.transcript_quote: you want to find the highest point of price action, and you want to find the lowest point of price action
confluences.name: premarket_high_low
confluences.description: Mark the highest and lowest points of price action in that pre-market range.

confluences.transcript_quote: When price trades to one of those areas
confluences.name: trade_to_level
confluences.description: Wait for price to trade into the pre-market high or low area before acting.

confluences.transcript_quote: the three things that we want to look for is we want to look for breakouts, we want to look for retests, and we want to look for liquidity sweeps
confluences.name: breakout_retest_sweep
confluences.description: Only trade the level if price gives a breakout, a retest, or a liquidity sweep.

confluences.transcript_quote: look for an increase in the volume to confirm that the breakout is actually valid
confluences.name: volume_confirmation
confluences.description: Use increased volume to confirm the breakout.

confluences.transcript_quote: look for that confirmation on the retest
confluences.name: retest_confirmation
confluences.description: Require confirmation on the retest before entering.

confluences.transcript_quote: a liquidity sweep is going to be a brief fake out below or above the level
confluences.name: liquidity_sweep
confluences.description: A liquidity sweep is a brief fakeout below or above the level.

confluences.name: patient_execution
confluences.description: Avoid early entries and wait for confirmation.
